airport.name: Parry Sound/Frying Pan Island-Sans Souci Seaplane Base

summary: Parry Sound/Frying Pan Island-Sans Souci Seaplane Base (YSI) is a small bush-flying seaplane base situated in the heart of Ontario's Georgian Bay cottage country. It primarily serves private aircraft and charter operators providing access to the Sans Souci and Frying Pan Island communities, which are otherwise reachable only by boat. The base reflects the region's longstanding reliance on float-equipped aircraft to connect remote island cottagers to the mainland.
faqs:
Q: What type of airport is YSI?
A: YSI is a seaplane base that accommodates float-equipped aircraft only, with no runway facilities.

Q: Who typically uses this seaplane base?
A: It is used mainly by private pilots, charter operators, and cottagers traveling to and from Sans Souci and Frying Pan Island in Georgian Bay.

Q: Are there scheduled commercial flights to YSI?
A: No regular scheduled service operates to this base; flights are typically private or on-demand charters.

Q: Is the base operational year-round?
A: Operations are generally seasonal, aligned with ice-free conditions on Georgian Bay, typically from late spring through fall.
transport_tips: Access to the base is by boat from Parry Sound or by float plane, as there are no road connections to Frying Pan Island. Visitors should arrange ground transport in the town of Parry Sound, located on the mainland, before or after their flight. Charter services from larger centres such as Toronto or Muskoka can be booked in advance during peak cottage season.
local_tip: Dock etiquette is important here—signal your approach by slow circling the base area before landing, as multiple private docks share the narrow channels around Frying Pan Island.
